recomps.name: Majora ReMasked

original.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D

assets.needs: Your own decrypted Majora's Mask 3D USA Rev 1 (v1.1) ROM as .3ds/.cci, chosen in the app's setup. Optional for model mods: a decrypted Ocarina of Time 3D ROM (Adult/Dark Link) and a Twilight Princess GameCube ISO/RVZ (TP Link).
assets.location: Picked with the system file picker and copied to <root>/game/game.cci, where <root> is /sdcard/mm3dport once the app has All files access (shared-v1 in shared_prefs/dekui-storage.xml) or /data/data/io.github.otpr26.dekuifork/files/dekui before that.
assets.notes: With All files access granted and the ROM imported, it boots into the game.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings (pages General, Controls, Touch, Graphics, Audio, HUD, Difficulty, Restoration, Quality of life, Mods, Cheats, About); the same settings are in the in-game menu.
settings.summary: Graphics page: frame rate (Original 30 FPS / 60 FPS CPU interpolation, the default / 60 FPS GPU interpolation), Field of View 45-70 (65), camera distance, enemy and prop draw distance, internal resolution 1-9x, Fix bloom, VSync, shader cache, async shaders, custom textures. Gameplay: Difficulty (damage taken, potion healing, prices), Restoration (Project Restoration options), Quality of life (walk/climb/swim speed, no low-heart beep, no Tatl reminders), player-model mods.

recomps.controls: Azahar input layer: controllers map on the Controls page; an on-screen touch HUD (ReMaskedTouchHud) with its own Touch page. Bindings are stored in the data folder. Not tested on the Thor.
recomps.display: Single-screen Majora's Mask 3D (DekUI moves the bottom-screen HUD onto the main picture, Wii U style). Built on Azahar, which can drive a second display (SecondaryDisplayPresentation; Layout/secondary_display_layout default 4 'Opposite Screen'); what it shows on the Thor's bottom screen was not checked.
recomps.saves: Under the data root (/sdcard/mm3dport once shared storage is on): Azahar's sdmc/nand tree plus mods and HUD settings.
recomps.notes: The app asks for MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE to use /sdcard/mm3dport. 0.4.6 released 2026-11-22. Release APKs share one signer (73e73470...), so updates install over. Uses Azahar (3DS emulator), Python via Chaquopy (mod generation) and Project Restoration. The repo was renamed from OTPR26/DekUI-Fork (the old URL redirects); it is a fork of tgacquin/mm3d-dekui.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys (version, install time, permissions), data dirs, the ROM's header bytes. APK: jadx of DekuiSettingsActivity, DekuiStorage, DekuiPresentationStore, SettingsFile, Int/BooleanSetting; arrays.xml. Web: GitHub API for the repo (name, license, parent, releases) and the Recompa index (package -> OTPR26/ReMasked, same signer). Not checked: controls, second-screen behaviour, save paths after first run.

recomps.name: Recompa

assets.needs: None for itself. It is a launcher/store that finds, installs and updates native Android ports; each port needs its own game data.
assets.location: Not applicable.
assets.notes: Its catalogue (https://recompa.app/index.json, 734 ports) lists six of the other recomps here with their upstream repos and signing keys: Majora ReMasked, Mareshine, Mario Kart DS, Metroid Fusion, Paper Cut and Skies of Arcadia. PokeDaisy is not in it.

settings.in_app_menu: Inside Recompa.
settings.summary: Launcher preferences only; no game settings. No adapter.

recomps.controls: Controller-navigable launcher (not tested).
recomps.display: Has a SecondScreenActivity for dual-screen handhelds (not tested).
recomps.saves: None.
recomps.notes: v0.5.1 released 2026-11-23. Needs REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES/REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES to install and remove ports; it could replace manual updates for the ports above, but an app signed with a different key (Mario Kart DS) still needs an uninstall.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs. APK: jadx manifest and prefs names. Web: GitHub API, recompa.app/index.json.

recomps.name: PokeDaisy

original.title: Pokemon Game Boy, Game Boy Color, GBA and DS games and ROM hacks

update.channel: manual APK from pokedaisy.com (latest listed there: 1.6.2.2)

assets.needs: Your own Pokemon ROMs (.gb/.gbc/.gba/.nds) and ROM hacks.
assets.location: Scans the folders in prefs key roms_folders (one entry per ROM folder, e.g. /storage/<sd-card>/Roms/GBA). Cocoon also lists it as a player, so it can be launched with a ROM file.
assets.notes: files/rom-titles.tsv lists the games it recognises; other ROMs in the scanned folders are marked unsupported (U) in rom-folder-scan.tsv.

settings.in_app_menu: Library > Settings (tabs), plus a quick menu in game.
settings.summary: Picture aspect (Original/Stretch/Expand; Expand is stored as WIDE), smoothing (xBRZ/xBR/ScaleFX), screen filter (LCD/scanlines/CRT), DS layout, DS resolution 1-8x, DS core (Auto/melonDS/DSperate), fast-forward and rewind, swap screens, single-screen mode, and many Pokemon-specific helpers (instant text, EXP share, level cap, HM-free, reusable TMs, shiny odds, day/night, follower).

recomps.controls: Built-in controller support with hotkeys (hotkeys_enabled), on-screen touch controls with skins, layouts and opacity.
recomps.display: Made for dual-screen handhelds: game on the top screen and a live companion (party, battle info, boxes) on the bottom screen; DS games can use both screens in several layouts; single_screen and swap_screens options.
recomps.saves: /sdcard/Android/data/com.pokedaisy.app/files/saves/ by default, or the folder in saves_dir_override; extra_save_dirs adds more. Save backups (save_backups_keep, default 10).
recomps.notes: The prefs file counts launches (app_open_count). It can hold secrets once you sign in (ra_token, ra_web_api_key, ss_password, steamgriddb_api_key): never print them. Firebase Crashlytics is bundled (crash_reports_enabled, off by default). GitHub source: a search result named lidor30/pokedaisy but the GitHub API returns 404 for it (deleted or private); github.com/tommiperfect31/pokedaisy has the same description but no releases or license, so its relation is unconfirmed. No repo URL recorded.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys, prefs file, files/*.tsv, external folders. APK: jadx of Prefs, NewFeatures, enums (GameAspect, Smoothing, ScreenFilter, GridStrength, FfMode, DsCore, DsLayout), SavesLocation. Web: pokedaisy.com (version), GitHub search. Not checked: the repo, the license.

recomps.name: The Minish Cap

original.title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap

project.name: Project Picori (zeldaret/tmc PC port) - Minish Cap Dual Screen

assets.needs: The Minish Cap GBA ROM, USA (SHA-1 b4bd50e4131b027c334547b4524e2dbbd4227130), named baserom.gba. EU/JP ROMs also load (baserom_eu.gba / baserom_jp.gba) but run as a hybrid on the USA build.
assets.location: /sdcard/Android/data/dev.picori.tmc/files/baserom.gba; the port extracts rom_data/ (2,789 chunk files), assets/ and assets_src/ next to it on first run.
assets.notes: baserom.gba is 16,777,216 bytes. The port extracts rom_data and assets on the first run.

settings.in_app_menu: Port settings menu: Select+Start on a gamepad (F8 on keyboard). Bottom screen > Settings tab: hide top HUD, widescreen, panel backdrop, map toggles and the port-wide toggles.
settings.summary: config.json (nlohmann JSON, 4-space indent) is rewritten on every setting change. Worth knowing: render_backend (software on Android by default; gpu needed for CRT/LCD shaders and .glslp presets), upscale_method (nearest/linear/xbrz_nearest/xbrz_linear), frame_time_ns (60 FPS cap), widescreen_enabled and aspect_mode, hide_top_hud, second_screen_* panel options, autosave, touch controls, randomizer options, accessibility audio cues and TTS.

recomps.controls: SDL3 gamepad and keyboard bindings in config.json 'bindings' (SDL_GAMEPAD button ids / SDLK codes). Defaults: A=0, B=1, soft X/Y on 2/3, L=9, R=10, Start=6, Select=4, roll-attack macro on 8, L2/R2 axes 4/5. Touch overlay on by default (touch_controls, joystick scheme). Select+Start opens the port menu. Start opens the game's pause menu unless game_pause_menu is false.
recomps.display: Game on the top screen; bottom screen is a Presentation with Map (follow cam, zoom, Windcrest pins), Dungeon automap, Quest, Items (touch equip) and Settings. second_screen_swap puts the game on the bottom panel instead (read by TMCLauncherActivity at launch). Built with a 384-pixel widescreen path (widescreen_enabled, aspect_mode).
recomps.saves: /sdcard/Android/data/dev.picori.tmc/files/tmc.sav (8 KB, active_save_profile), state_quick.bin and state_auto_0..2.bin (autosave every 60 s), tmc.randomizer.
recomps.notes: Release v1.2 (tmc-dual-screen-v1.2.apk, 2026-08-19, SHA-256 9f666877...) is the latest release. versionName 0.8.3 is the Picori port version. Lineage: zeldaret/tmc decompilation -> MatheoVignaud/tmc (PC port) -> 999sian/tmc ('Project Picori') -> Raekwon1603/tmc-android -> samyost1/tmc-android (Thor dual-screen mod). The native binary has a GitHub update check against MatheoVignaud/tmc (TMC_NO_UPDATE_CHECK disables it); that is the PC port's channel, not this APK's.
recomps.verified: Device: version, install time, config.json content, ROM and extracted data present, save files. APK: SHA-256 against GitHub release, libmain.so strings. Source at tag v1.2: port/port_runtime_config.cpp (keys, defaults, value parsing), port_ppu.cpp (upscale names), port_gpu_renderer.cpp, TMCLauncherActivity.java, README. Not checked: changing a setting and relaunching.

recomps.name: Apotris

assets.needs: Nothing. Apotris is free original homebrew; the APK carries all music, sound and shaders.
assets.location: /sdcard/Documents/Apotris/assets (extracted from the APK on first run; extracted.txt marks it)
assets.notes: Not a recomp of a commercial game: an original block-stacking game written for the GBA that ships native PC/Android builds. The GBA ROM build can also sit in Cocoon's library as a separate game.

settings.in_app_menu: Main menu > Settings (in-game, controller-driven).
settings.summary: All options (handling DAS/ARR, skins, ghost piece, shaders such as crt-lottes/zfast_lcd, audio) are stored inside the 32 KB binary save Apotris.sav, the same savefile struct as the GBA build. No text config, so no adapter. preferences.txt holds only '1' plus a newline (meaning not checked).

recomps.controls: SDL2 game controller (gamecontrollerdb). Remapping in the in-game Controls menu, stored in Apotris.sav. No touch overlay in the Java layer (plain SDLActivity).
recomps.display: Single screen (top). Plain SDLActivity with no secondary-display code.
recomps.saves: /sdcard/Documents/Apotris/Apotris.sav (32 KB; settings and high scores together). storage_path.txt in /data/data/com.akouzoukos.apotris/files points the game at /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Apotris/.
recomps.notes: The official release zip Apotris-v4.2.0Android.zip holds Apotris.apk (15,116,136 bytes); the checked APK matched it in size. A separate unofficial port exists (github.com/SanGraphic/Apotris-Android, package not checked); this entry covers the official build.
recomps.verified: On device: dumpsys version/install date, storage_path.txt, /sdcard/Documents/Apotris listing, preferences.txt contents, APK contents. From web: GitHub repo akouzoukos/apotris exists (no releases or licence listed there). Original release year not confirmed. Save format not decoded.

recomps.name: AM2R

original.title: Metroid II: Return of Samus (AM2R fan remake)

assets.needs: Original AM2R 1.1 (AM2R_11.zip), patched into an Android APK on a PC with AM2RLauncher or with AM2R-Autopatcher-Android. The resulting APK contains the whole game (assets/game.droid), so nothing is read from storage at run time.
assets.location: Inside the installed APK (assets/game.droid, music .ogg, lang/*.ini).
assets.notes: The game data string in game.droid reads 'V1.5.5' (Community Updates 1.5.5); the APK versionName 1.5.3 comes from the wrapper template. The patched APK installs with the system package installer.

settings.in_app_menu: Title screen or pause > Options: Display, Sound, Controls, Joypad, Extras, Gameplay.
settings.summary: config.ini is a GameMaker ini (values written as quoted reals, e.g. Widescreen="1.000000"). Display: Widescreen, Scale, VSync, HUD/map/hints, Metroid counter. Controls: aiming style, missile toggle/hold, classic morph ball, spiderball style, auto-climb, auto-morph, analog walking, touch control scale, joystick/XInput button ids. Extras: Fusion suit style, early baby Metroid, extreme lab Metroids, IGT display, low health alarm, controller button prompts. Gameplay: Insanity mode.

recomps.controls: GameMaker joystick and XInput-style pad mappings in [Control] (EnableXBJoypad, EnableJoystick). Android touch controls scale TouchScale (1-8, shown in the menu as 9-value). Controller button tips: Controller=0 is XBox. Not tested on the Thor.
recomps.display: Single screen. Widescreen=1 gives a 16:9 view (needs a room transition to apply). Old GameMaker runner (target SDK 23, armeabi-v7a only), so it runs as a 32-bit app.
recomps.saves: /data/data/com.companyname.AM2RWrapper/files/save1 (also save2, save3 when used). Root needed; files are mode 600 owned by the app uid.
recomps.notes: Package com.companyname.AM2RWrapper is the AM2RLauncher/Autopatcher Android wrapper template. AM2R-Community-Updates publishes source only (no GitHub releases); updates come by re-patching with AM2RLauncher's 'Community Updates (Latest)' profile and reinstalling.
recomps.verified: Device: version, install time and installer, config.ini and save file. APK: contents, options.ini, game.droid strings (V1.5.5, config.ini, save names). Source: scripts/load_gameoptions.gml and objects/oOptions*.object.gmx from AM2R-Community-Updates (HEAD, not tag-matched to 1.5.5), labels from the APK's lang/english.ini.

recomps.name: Metroid Fusion

assets.needs: Your own Metroid Fusion USA ROM (.gba or .zip), SHA-1 ca33f4348c2c05dd330d37b97e2c5a69531dfe87. No BIOS needed: the open Cult-of-GBA BIOS is bundled.
assets.location: Imported with 'Importar ROM' and stored at /data/data/io.github.genissonemilio.metroidfusion.albumtest/files/roms/fusion_usa.gba (root-only).
assets.notes: The app has no option to hide the touch controls. The opacity pref in fusion.xml can be set below the menu's 30 % minimum (15 % was used in testing).

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher buttons 'Imagem' (pixel mode) and 'Controles' (touch size, opacity, sound). The UI is in Portuguese.
settings.summary: Image: Pixel perfeito (sharp integer scaling) or Suave (Scale2x, the default). Touch controls size 80-130 %, opacity 30-90 %, sound on/off. Nothing else.

recomps.controls: Touch controls by default; controller input through SDL2. D-pad move, A/B actions, L/R secondary, Start map; the BSL Album (screenshot gallery) opens from the map with R.
recomps.display: Single screen, original aspect ratio with integer scaling (margins on some screens).
recomps.saves: /data/data/io.github.genissonemilio.metroidfusion.albumtest/files/saves/fusion.sav (32 KB SRAM, root-only); 'Exportar save' copies it out. Quick states from the in-game menu.
recomps.notes: Repo license shows NOASSERTION in the GitHub API (no recognised license file). Derived from the author's ZeldaMinishCapAndroid and MinishCapRecomp/gbarecomp. The package name ends in .albumtest; it is the 0.1.0 release (only release, 2026-10-29); Recompa lists it with one 'great' report on an AYN Thor.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs, sha1sum of a USA ROM. APK: jadx of FusionSetupActivity, RomImporter, GbaGameConfig; assets/payload/variants/fusion/game.toml. Web: GitHub search/API, Recompa index.

recomps.name: Luigis Mansion Recomp

project.name: Luigi's Mansion Recompiled (Android port by MsBunnana & JayElDragon)

assets.needs: Luigi's Mansion USA disc image (.iso or .rvz), picked in Game Files; play it in place (SAF link, recommended) or copy it into the app. Optional DLC 'Premium Deluxe 2.2.1' (.xdelta or GameBanana .zip) is built from an .iso (not .rvz).
assets.location: Linked SAF document (pref in lm.xml, DiscLink) or a copy inside /data/data/com.personal.luigismansion/files.
assets.notes: Options > Controls > Hide with Controller hides the touch controls while a controller is in use.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Options (tabs: Graphics, Controls, Audio, Help). Presets Low-end/Balanced/Smooth/High quality/Maximum set FPS, resolution and MSAA together.
settings.summary: Frame rate 30/60 or any display rate up to 240 (default 120), resolution 1-4x, MSAA off/4x, screen format (4:3, Auto, 16:9, 16:10, 21:9, 32:9), HUD centred 4:3, VSync, sharp picture, Performance Mode, Auto Cool-down, Boost CPU, custom texture packs, cheats (no damage, vacuum x4, mirror world, skip cutscenes).

recomps.controls: SDL gamepad; on-screen touch controls (on by default, opacity, haptics, hide with controller). Stick response curve (StickCurve). Controller mapping kept in settings.ini [controls] (port1_device).
recomps.display: Single screen, sensorLandscape (no secondary-display code in the APK).
recomps.saves: /data/data/com.personal.luigismansion/files/xdg/Luigi's Mansion Recompiled/USA/ (memory card). Automatic zip backups to /sdcard/Download/Luigi's Mansion Android/ after play; restore in Options > Help > Restore Saves.
recomps.notes: GitHub release V3.2 is versionName 3.2.1, versionCode 8 (2026-11-18); an older build reports versionCode 3, versionName 1.2. On first launch the app picks a device-tier preset (writes g_fps/g_res/g_msaa) unless those prefs already exist. A Safe Mode (after a crash) temporarily forces 30 fps, 1x, no AA, no texture pack. Two engine libs: libmain.so (base game) and libmain_pd.so (DLC).
recomps.verified: On device: dumpsys, data dir. APK (versionName 1.2 build): GameSettings.write (prefs -> settings.ini mapping), OptionsView (keys, labels, ranges), DisplayRates, SaveBackup. Web: JayElDragon/luigis-mansion-android build.gradle and releases; rob646464 upstream repo. Settings of newer releases may differ.

recomps.name: Skies of Arcadia Legends

update.channel: GitHub releases, pre-releases included (the release has several assets; the Android one matches android\.apk$)

assets.needs: Your own Skies of Arcadia Legends disc: USA GEAE8P, Europe GEAP8P or Japan GEAJ8P (RVZ, ISO, GCM, GCZ, WIA or CISO). Optional: Dreamcast discs (CHD) for Dreamcast music and the uncensored models, an HD texture pack.
assets.location: Imported once in Settings > Disc, extracted and patched into <data>/Games/<discID>/, where <data> is /sdcard/Android/data/com.skiesofarcadia.recomp/files (the default; 'Data folder > Change' can move it).
assets.notes: An imported USA disc takes 1.3 GB in <data>/Games/GEAE8P. Widescreen patches are cached in /data/data/com.skiesofarcadia.recomp/cache/dolpatches/.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings (tabs Graphics, Gameplay, Language, Sound, Dreamcast, Controls, Saves, Disc, About); in game hold Z and press Start, or Select (SkiesHotkeys Menu).
settings.summary: Graphics: Picture (Widescreen 16:9 / Match screen / 4:3), HUD position, Frame rate 30 or 60 (interpolated), Resolution 1-6x, MSAA, texture filtering, anisotropy, scaling, V-Sync, FPS, HD textures, renderer Vulkan/OpenGL ES, custom GPU driver. Gameplay: camera control, battle and field speed, encounter rate, Hold B, EXP/Gold/Magic EXP multipliers, Invincible. Saves: auto-save interval.

recomps.controls: Dolphin input layer. GCPad1 maps to the Thor's built-in pad as Android/1/Odin Controller, with rumble on the device motor. [SkiesHotkeys] in GCPadNew.ini: Menu = Select, Invincible = L3 | R3. The touch overlay is Android/ShowInputOverlay.
recomps.display: Single screen. Ini values: Widescreen 1 = 16:9, FrameMode 1 = 60 fps, InternalResolution 3 = 1080p, OutputResampling 5 = Sharp; renderer Vulkan or OpenGL ES.
recomps.saves: Memory card: <data>/GC/USA/Card A/ (GCI folder). Save states: <data>/StateSaves/state-skies-slot<N>.sav (about 30 MB each). Back up with Settings > Saves > Back up saves before updating. Play time is kept per disc ID in TimePlayed.ini (milliseconds, hex).
recomps.notes: 0.83.0-beta runs on a Dolphin-derived engine (org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu.skies.*). v0.94.0-beta (2026-11-25) brings a new engine on the Aurora renderer: settings, saves and the data folder carry over, but save states made by the new engine do not load in 0.83, and its Renderer setting replaces Dolphin's video backend settings. Upstream says to back up saves before updating. Releases are signed with upstream's key (e2c00b0b...), so updates install over. The app asks for MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys, the Obtainium app JSON, every Config ini, GameSettings, shared_prefs, folder sizes. APK: jadx of SkiesSettingsPanel (show() dumped as raw code), SkiesLauncherActivity; libmain strings. Web: GitHub API releases; v0.94 release notes from Obtainium's stored changelog.

recomps.name: Paper Cut (US)

update.channel: GitHub releases (one APK per disc release: papercut-<v>-eu-android-arm64.apk); the app can download and install its own updates

assets.needs: Your own US disc image, game ID G8ME01 (.iso, .gcm or .rvz). This is the US app; upstream ships separate EU (G8MP01) and JP (G8MJ01) APKs.
assets.location: Added to the launcher's library with the system file picker (persistable content:// URI); nothing is copied to a fixed path.
assets.notes: Add the disc with 'Add a disc image'. With 'Skip to this disc next time' on, the app boots straight to the game. Settings > Gameplay has presets such as Vanilla+.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings, or in game: the Start menu's settings page (controller Back/Select, or a three-finger tap).
settings.summary: framerate 60/120/144/240/display (frame interpolation), resolution (window or 1-8x 640x480), widescreen, wide HUD, 4x MSAA, sharp texture filter, no pop-in, VSync, FPS overlay; text speed, skip intro, run speed, fast-forward speed; EU: language and 50 Hz.

recomps.controls: SDL3/Aurora input: controllers, keyboard and mouse, and touch (on-screen stick and buttons with size/opacity, auto-run, fixed stick, tap = A).
recomps.display: Dual-screen aware: when a second display exists it shows a companion page there (Party, Map, Battle info, Crystal Stars) through an Android Presentation (TtydCompanion). Recompa's index also marks it dual_screen. Any aspect ratio; landscape by default.
recomps.saves: Memory cards beside settings.txt in Aurora's user folder (expected /data/data/dev.ttyd.port.us/files/, root-only).
recomps.notes: The EU and US builds are separate apps; install the one that matches the disc's region. Touch buttons hide when the controller is used.
recomps.verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs. APK: jadx (TtydActivity, TtydCompanion), native strings (settings.txt, disc IDs). Source: settings_aurora.c and settings.h at tag v0.5.1 (key list, ranges, defaults), README, docs. Not checked: the user-folder path on Android (SDL pref path assumed), whether the EU app takes a US disc.

recomps.name: Dusklight

original.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

assets.needs: Twilight Princess GameCube USA disc image (GZ2E01), ISO/CISO/RVZ-style image, picked in the pre-launch UI.
assets.location: Read in place through a SAF document URI (content://...) stored in config.json backend.isoPath.
assets.notes: backend.isoVerification = 1 (Success) means the picked image passed the hash check.

settings.in_app_menu: Pre-launch screen > Settings, or in game via the Dusklight menu (bindable action openDusklightMenu). A Graphics Tuner carousel covers resolution, shadows, bloom, depth of field and texture packs.
settings.summary: Internal resolution (Auto or 1-12x), shadow resolution 1-8x, frame interpolation (Off/Capped/Unlimited) with framerate cap 30-540, bloom and depth of field (Off/Classic/Dusklight), letterboxing, menu scaling, many QoL toggles (fast climbing, instant saves, bigger wallets...), gyro aim, touch controls. Presets include 'Dusklight'.

recomps.controls: SDL gamepad; the Thor pad is saved as 'Odin Controller_2020_0111.controller' mapping. Per-port action bindings (call Midna, first-person, map, turbo) in config.json actionBindings.*_port0..3. Gyro aim option. Optional on-screen touch controls (game.enableTouchControls).
recomps.display: Official build is single-screen (no secondary-display code in the APK). A dual-screen fork exists (github.com/igawa6/dusklight; also Darkaxt/Dusklight-Android-Dual-Screen-Bleeding-Edge).
recomps.saves: Memory card GCI folder: /data/data/dev.twilitrealm.dusk/files/USA/Card A/01-GZ2E-gczelda2.gci (backend.cardFileType 1 = GCI Folder). Root-only path; back up with su.
recomps.notes: v2.0.3 released 2026-09-30. Ships bundled mods (cosmetics, luau_runtime, randomizer .dusk files) and a Dawn pipeline cache. Launch args can be passed with am start --es borealis_args "--backend vulkan". Logs in files/logs; a run that stops with 'Surface present failed' there is a renderer failure (seen with v2.0.2).
recomps.verified: On device: dumpsys, config.json (read in full), files listing, save folder, log. Source: TwilitRealm/dusklight at tag v2.0.2 (settings.h/.cpp, ui/settings.cpp, ui/graphics_tuner.cpp, ui/preset.cpp, config.cpp, platforms/android/README.md). LICENSE.md is CC0 1.0.

recomps.name: Mareshine

update.channel: GitHub releases (the app also checks for updates itself at start, setting SMS_UPDATE_CHECK)

assets.needs: Your own Super Mario Sunshine disc image, USA GMSE01 (a PAL disc goes in iso/pal).
assets.location: Imported into <data>/iso/, where <data> is /sdcard/Android/data/io.github.them3dium.mareshine/files by default or the folder in shared_prefs/sunshine.xml key data_dir.
assets.notes: An imported USA disc lands at <data>/iso/GMSE01.iso. The game boots in 16:9.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings (Video presets Recommended/Low/Medium/High/Ultra, then Resolution, Picture, Effects, Graphics driver, Controls, Cheats, Mods, Achievements, Updates).

recomps.controls: Godot input with controller support and a touch UI (this is the 'SuperMarioWorldRemasteredPlus.apk' build with touch controls; the release also has a No Touch UI APK). Touch controls can be disabled in the game. Up to 4-player co-op (CoopManager). Not tested on the Thor.
recomps.display: Single screen; Godot viewport stretch mode 'viewport', aspect 'ignore'. Windowed by default on Android, so system bars cover part of the game until Window Type is set to Fullscreen (BTFighter v1.1 release notes).
recomps.saves: /data/data/com.example.supermarioworldremasteredplus/files/Saves/*.sav (JSON, SaveManager.gd, three slots). Root needed to back up.
recomps.notes: Godot 4.4.stable.official engine (libgodot_android.so). Fan remake originally by JHDev2006 (Super-Mario-World-Remastered-Public), continued as Remastered Plus by Boswer811; BTFighter's fork published the 'experimental Android build' on the v1.1 release on 2026-03-22. That release's SuperMarioWorldRemasteredPlus.apk has SHA-256 28bff031.... The package name com.example.* is the Godot export default. Godot's Android user:// is getFilesDir() regardless of the project's custom_user_dir_name (checked in Godot 4.4 source).
recomps.verified: Device: version, install time, data dir, ROM lookup. APK: SHA-256 against the GitHub release asset, project.binary (app name, custom user dir, autoloads), decompressed GDScript bytecode of SettingsManager, SaveManager and rom_checker (paths, keys, Android Documents lookup). Source of BTFighter's repo for defaults and option labels. Not checked: running the game.

recomps.name: Super Metroid

assets.needs: Super Metroid (Japan, USA) (En,Ja) SNES ROM. Picked once with the document picker on first launch; the app copies it to sm.smc.
assets.location: /sdcard/Android/data/com.raekwon.supermetroid/files/sm.smc (AndroidImpl_GetRomPath = SDL external storage path + /sm.smc).
assets.notes: The first start right after import shows a black screen; later starts work.

settings.in_app_menu: Bottom screen > Setup tab (status strip on map, hide main HUD, save states, clear map markers, autosave on exit). Everything else only in sm.ini.
settings.summary: sm.ini (snesrev format) is copied from the APK on first launch and read once at game start: NewRenderer, EnhancedMode7, NoSpriteLimits, IgnoreAspectRatio, LinearFiltering, audio rate/buffer, DisableFrameDelay, Autosave, gamepad map, quicksave/quickload combos (L1+R1+Start / L1+R1+Back). Android ignores OutputMethod (always SDL_Renderer), Fullscreen and WindowSize; AutoRun currently does nothing (gameplay runs on the bundled SNES emulator core). Bottom-screen toggles are in SharedPreferences 'secondscreen'. No widescreen option.

recomps.controls: SDL2 gamepad. On the Thor, A/B are remapped to the Nintendo-style layout in main.c, and L2/R2 cycle the armed ammo (handled in MainActivity.dispatchKeyEvent, keycodes 104/105). Quicksave L1+R1+Start, quickload L1+R1+Back (slot 0). No touch controls for gameplay; the bottom screen is touch.
recomps.display: Game on the top screen (immersive fullscreen, 4:3). Bottom screen is an Android Presentation with Map (live explored map, HP/ammo strip, markers), Items and Setup tabs. Known issue from the README: an occasional black screen when launched right after another game from Cocoon; closing and relaunching fixes it.
recomps.saves: /sdcard/Android/data/com.raekwon.supermetroid/files/saves/ (sm.srm in-game SRAM plus sm.srm.bak, save%d.sav save states, autosave_thumb.bin).
recomps.notes: The v1.1 (Super.Metroid.Dual.Screen.apk) and v1.2 (app-debug.apk) release assets share SHA-256 57dddd0b...; v1.2 (2026-09-08) is the latest. The author has stopped work on this repo and moved to MetroidArch, a dual-screen RetroArch fork (https://github.com/Raekwon1603/RetroArch, branch metroidarch-dual-screen, package com.metroidarch.app.aarch64). Gameplay runs on snesrev/sm's bundled 65816/SPC700 emulator core rather than the decompiled C. Known open bug: rapid uncharged beam shots are silent after the first.

GitHub: README, src/config.c and src/main.c (ini parsing, sm.user.ini precedence, chdir to external files dir). Not checked: running the game.
